sentences.text: A browser sends a request along the wire to the server.
The server answers, and next to it a cache remembers the reply, so the next request is fast.

scenes.narration: A thermostat has to read the room, then diff it against the target, then heat the room. That closes the loop, and the loop repeats all day long.

visual.heading: A feedback loop
visual.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 1700 560"><g id="measure"><circle cx="300" cy="260" r="120" fill="primary"/><text x="300" y="272" text-anchor="middle" size="title">read</text></g><g id="compare"><line x1="440" y1="260" x2="710" y2="260" arrow="end"/><circle cx="850" cy="260" r="120" fill="secondary"/><text x="850" y="272" text-anchor="middle" size="title">diff</text></g><g id="adjust"><line x1="990" y1="260" x2="1260" y2="260" arrow="end"/><circle cx="1400" cy="260" r="120" fill="accent"/><text x="1400" y="272" text-anchor="middle" size="title">heat</text></g><g id="loop"><path d="M 1400 400 C 1400 560, 300 560, 300 400" arrow="end" stroke="danger"/></g></svg>

sentences.text: A thermostat has to read the room, then diff it against the target, then heat the room.
